job.job_description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Developer / Team Lead

Location: Hyderabad

Industry: AgriTech | Weather Forecasting | Remote Sensing

Experience Required: 78 years

Job Type: Full-Time

Position Overview:

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer/Team Lead

to join our team and lead the development of robust, scalable, and secure web applications. The

ideal candidate will have a strong command of React.js, Node.js, Express.js, Python,

PostgreSQL or MongoDB, and expertise in implementing secure authentication protocols like

JWT. You will take ownership of projects, mentor junior developers, and collaborate with cross-

functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the design, development, and deployment of full-stack web applications.
Develop and maintain server-side APIs using Node.js and Express.js with a focus on

performance and scalability.

Build and optimize dynamic, user-friendly front-end components using React.js.
Handling server-side logic, database management, and API development using Python

(FastAPI Library)

Architect, integrate, and manage databases such as PostgreSQL or MongoDB to ensure

efficient data storage and retrieval.

Implement secure user authentication and authorization workflows using JWT and other best

practices.

Drive the adoption of coding standards, best practices, and modern development

methodologies.

Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues across the stack.
Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to junior developers.
Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, product managers, and other stakeholders to align

technical solutions with business needs.

Stay updated with emerging technologies and trends, recommending improvements to

processes and tools.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
7-8 years of professional experience in full-stack development, with a proven track record of

building and maintaining scalable applications.

Strong expertise in:
Python for backend development.
React.js for creating interactive, responsive front-end interfaces.
Node.js and Express.js for server-side programming.
Databases: PostgreSQL and/or MongoDB.
Secure authentication mechanisms like JWT.
Solid understanding of RESTful API design and microservices architecture.
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (ES6+).
Experience with version control tools like Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with experience working in Agile

environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms like

Kubernetes.

Exposure to DevOps practices, including infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of GraphQL APIs and WebSocket-based real-time applications.
Strong leadership skills with experience mentoring junior developers.
